cases.title: F&F: salary, EL encashment, notice recovery, gratuity
Kent feed → muster → payroll: calendar month with absences, half day, dedupe and backfill
cases.derivation: June 2026 via the simulator: P on two doors 1 Jun; no punch 2 Jun (A); 09:00–14:00 3 Jun (240 min → HD); in-only 4 Jun (A); duplicate delivery 5 Jun (P, deduped); 09:00–12:30 6 Jun (150 min → A); no punches 8–13 Jun (6 A) → Sun 14 Jun forfeited; 16 Jun buffered, arrives in the 2nd sync (P). LOP = 9 A + 0.5 HD + 1 unpaid WO = 10.5 → 19.5/30; gross 19500; PT 130 (15k–25k)

cases.title: Kent feed with a 26–25 cycle: only window punches reach payroll
cases.derivation: att.cycle_start_day=26, July payroll: window 26 Jun–25 Jul. A 29 Jun + A 14 Jul + HD 20 Jul (09:00–14:00) → LOP 2.5 → 28.5/31. Punches 26–31 Jul (incl. a missed 28 Jul) are after the cut-off: they stay unlocked and are counted in August

cases.title: Kent door not mapped to a location: absences are held and the month cannot lock until HR maps it
cases.derivation: Door G1 has no location: the no-punch day 2 Jun stays held (no day record), the lock is refused (attendance_complete, recompute_drained, sync_watermark). After HR maps the door the day resolves to A, the month locks and pays 29/30
